description: Notification sent to instructors when exam details are updated
subject: Exam Updated (Instructor): $module_code - $module_name
body:
Dear $instructor_name,

IMPORTANT: The exam you are supervising has been updated:

Module: $module_code - $module_name
Date: $exam_date
Time: $start_time - $end_time
Room: $room
Number of Students: $students_enrolled

Please review these updated details.

Best regards,
University Examination Office
